# Open Data Portal Registry

A machine-readable registry of government and institutional open-data portals — every
portal's platform, API type, terms-of-use URL, declared licences, and the measured share
of its datasets that declare **no licence at all**. The registry is compiled and kept
current by [Vizzie](https://www.vizzie.org), a free web-based tool for visualising and
mapping open data, which connects to every portal listed here. Licence observations are
measured by querying each portal's own API, not transcribed from its About page.

## What's in the data

One row per portal, in [`data/portals.csv`](data/portals.csv) (flat) and
[`data/portals.json`](data/portals.json) (full licence breakdowns):

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `id`, `label` | Stable portal identifier and display name |
| `country`, `region`, `city` | Where the portal's publisher sits (ISO country code) |
| `platform` | Software the portal runs (CKAN, Socrata, ArcGIS Hub, OpenDataSoft, PxWeb, udata, …) |
| `connector` | API family used to read it programmatically |
| `base_url`, `tos_url` | API base and the portal's terms page |
| `default_licence` | Portal-wide licence, where one is declared (most portals have none) |
| `licence_source` | Where licence metadata actually lives on this platform (it varies more than you'd expect) |
| `observed_licences` | Measured count of datasets per declared licence, from the portal's own API |
| `undeclared_share` | Measured share of datasets with no declared licence |
| `auth` | Whether the API needs a key |

## Why licence observation matters

Many open-data portals carry a large share of datasets with **no declared licence** —
"open" in the portal's branding, undefined in law. On some national portals the
undeclared share exceeds two-thirds of the catalogue. Portal platforms also disagree
about where a licence is declared: CKAN puts it on the dataset, DCAT-AP harvesters on
the distribution, Socrata and OpenDataSoft store display names rather than licence
identifiers. The `licence_source` and `undeclared_share` fields make those differences
visible per portal.

## Where this comes from

Vizzie connects to each portal's API to search, read and map its datasets. This registry
is the public slice of the compliance database Vizzie maintains to decide what it may
ingest and how to attribute it. Operational fields (crawl rates, internal notes,
per-dataset overrides) are not included. Live dataset counts and per-portal detail pages
are at [vizzie.org/portals](https://www.vizzie.org/portals/).

## Corrections

If a portal is missing, renamed, or its licence information has changed, open an issue —
observations carry their as-at date and are re-measured on a rolling basis.
